theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_mass_measure_abs_continuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W + T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ μ : Measure (Eucl P), IsMassMeasure T μ → μ ≪ (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
